title.zh: BitMEX Sued in UK for Return of $27M in Bitcoin Over Unlicensed Derivatives
title.en: BitMEX Sued in UK for Return of $27M in Bitcoin Over Unlicensed Derivatives

current_state.zh: UK software engineer Lewis Barber has sued BitMEX operator HDR Global Trading in London's Commercial Court seeking the return of 324.8 BTC (~$27M), alleging the exchange traded with him in the UK without FCA authorization, with lawyers flagging potential similar claims from other UK traders.
